title: Nanopore Discrimination of Protein-Small-Molecule Drug Complexes at Near-Atomic Resolution.
authors: Jo, Junhyeok; Kim, Jin-Sik; Hwang, Sungbo; Jeong, Ki-Baek; Chi, Seung-Wook
one_liner_zh: 该文利用YaxAB纳米孔结合分子动力学模拟检测BRD4蛋白与小分子药物及组蛋白肽的互作，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和MD方法，但对象非蛋白质-DNA体系，且未聚焦TF-DNA结合，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: Nanopore is a single-molecule technology for sensing biomolecules. Biomolecular interactions are essential biological processes that govern biological functions and therapeutic responses. However, high-resolution nanopore sensing of biomolecular interactions, such as protein-ligand interactions, remains challenging. In this study, we demonstrate that a YaxAB nanopore with LiCl-modulated electrostatic potential enables detection of molecular interactions of the BRD4 protein with histone peptides, as well as diverse small-molecule drugs, at the single-molecule level. Our electrical recordings and molecular dynamics simulations confirm that the oscillating dynamics of BRD4 within the funneled YaxAB nanopore generate two-level current transitions between narrow- and wide-pore regions. Using the parameters derived from dual-level dynamics and their signal decomposition, a YaxAB nanopore sensing approach enables the sensitive discrimination of BRD4-small-molecule drug complexes with a subtle mass difference as small as 2.5 Da. This near-atomic, high-resolution sensing capability of YaxAB nanopores may enable applications in single-molecule-based drug discovery, proteomics, and diagnostics.
abstract_zh: 纳米孔是一种用于感知生物分子的单分子技术。生物分子相互作用是控制生物功能和治疗反应的基本生物过程。然而，高分辨率纳米孔感知生物分子相互作用（如蛋白质-配体相互作用）仍具挑战性。在本研究中，我们证明，具有LiCl调节静电势的YaxAB纳米孔能够在单分子水平上检测BRD4蛋白与组蛋白肽以及多种小分子药物的分子相互作用。我们的电记录和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟确认，BRD4在漏斗形YaxAB纳米孔内的振荡动力学在窄孔和宽孔区域之间产生双电平电流转换。利用从双电平动力学及其信号分解中获得的参数，YaxAB纳米孔感知方法能够灵敏地区分质量差异小至2.5 Da的BRD4-小分子药物复合物。YaxAB纳米孔的这种近原子级高分辨率感知能力可能促进在基于单分子的药物发现、蛋白质组学和诊断学中的应用。
